title: 8.2 Volume of a Solid of Revolution: Disks and Washers

icans: I can use the disk method to find a volume.
I can use the washer method when there is a hole.
I can find the radii when the axis is a line other than an axis.

vocab: the solid __________ by revolving a region about a line
V = π∫ R² dx, where R is the ___________ from the axis to the curve
V = π∫ (R² − r²) dx, with outer __________ R and inner radius r
